replies.author: KooDaLord
replies.body:
Overall, it is quite flat and boring. I do think it has potential however, just add something to it. At the moment it would have extremely dry gameplay, and honestly it just doesn't look good.

My suggestions:

"unflatten it" :P
Add detail in any way
Make some more pvp opportunities, at the moment they would just be running around a mountain.

-1 for now, but I'm sure you could change that into a +1 :)
